notes.title: Patch Notes 2/15/25
notes.content:
Patch Notes 2/15/25

* Fixed Compactors not Generating Income (with no prestige upgrade bug)
* Added 3 Buy Buttons in Prestige Shop for Faster Purchasing
* Fixed 20-PowerPlant Achievement counting as 25 instead of 20
* Fixed PP bug where upgrades didnt reflect the new values
* Fixed Prestige Power Plant Upgrade Not Giving 10% Power Bonus (Stacks)
* Fixed Stats Panel Incorrectly Displaying Power Usage and Income
* Some Achivements Should be Easier to Get Now!
* Misc Improvements Based on User Feedback

If you made it this far, thank you for playing! I will continue to put out new content and patches.

notes.title: Update notes for 2/6/2025
notes.content:
Bug Fixes and Patch Notes

Hello all! After gathering some feedback I have patched the following issues:


 Volume slider now works properly
 Mute button added
 Shop and building action UI now has a background for better visibility
 Starting buildings increased to 2 powerplants, 1 factory, 1 warehouse
